checks.text: Clicking the button "Add task" opens a form. Filling "Task name" with "Design", "Start date" with "2024-01-15", "Duration (days)" with "5", and clicking "Save" adds a bar labeled "Design" starting on Jan 15.
After adding "Design" (Jan 15, 5 days) and "Build" (Jan 20, 10 days), clicking the "Dependencies" tab shows a list containing "Design" and "Build".
In the "Dependencies" tab, selecting "Design" in the "Predecessor" dropdown for the "Build" row and clicking "Apply" adds a dependency line from "Design" to "Build" in the timeline view.
Clicking the "Export" button copies the text "Design: 2024-01-15 to 2024-01-19\nBuild: 2024-01-20 to 2024-01-29" to the clipboard.
Dragging the "Design" bar to start on Jan 10 updates its start date to 2024-01-10 and end date to 2024-01-14.
Clicking the "Delete" button on the "Build" task removes it from the timeline and the dependencies list.
Reload keeps the "Design" task with start date 2024-01-10 and duration 5 days.
